text: 1. Non-Chinese citizenship, good health conditions, younger than 35 years old. 2. Have a bachelor degree or above, with a grade point GPA of 2.6/4.0 or higher. 3. Applicants who are non-native English speakers, must have IELTS 5.5, TOEFL (IBT) 80 or higher. 4. Applicants for the scholarship must meet the scholarship application requirements.
